facades.name: Prins Hendrikkade front
facades.note: Cropped to the 25.8 m north front between the quarter-round corner (ring 0, 4.45 m from the elevation silhouette's viewer-left edge) and the west party wall (30.26 m). Rows as the model's: the ground storey is hidden behind a tram in both crops (unknown); the first, second and third storeys each seven axes (two stone end bays and five brick bays between the giant pilasters); the attic row of five segmental-hooded dormers plus the two end gables' three-light windows. Axes from the east end (crop px/50): stone 2.2 m, brick 5.9, 9.4, 12.9, 16.3, 19.8, stone 23.5. The front is mirror-symmetric about the third brick axis.

mixedRows.evidence: TMX7316060226-000030_pano_0006_000132 (2016), crop w01-341.alt.jpg at 50 px/m: gable lights 1.80/1.84 m, dormer lights 1.20-1.28 m

facades.name: east front
facades.note: Cropped to what the 2016 crop shows: the last five brick axes (from 17.5 m along the front from its south end) and the north stone bay, to the corner (12.6-35.8 m from the elevation silhouette's viewer-left edge; the entrance risalit of no. 33 and the first brick axis lie left of the crop). Rows: ground storey (rusticated), first, second and third storeys, and the attic row of five dormers plus the stone-bay gable's window. Cellar lights under the ground windows are mostly hidden by parked vans and blurs and are not modelled (they read as buried in the openings gate in every variant tried).
